rice leaf roller.fun_fact: Rice Leaf Roller is a key pest monitored in the IP102 benchmark dataset.

crop_impact.loss_description: Rice Leaf Roller causes significant damage to rice. Early detection is critical.

low: Monitor rice leaf roller activity weekly using sticky traps
Encourage natural predators in the field
Record sightings and track population trends
medium: Apply neem oil spray every 5-7 days for rice leaf roller
Remove and destroy heavily infested plant material
Use row covers to prevent further spread
Inspect neighbouring fields for spread
high: Apply targeted insecticide for rice leaf roller immediately
Contact your local agricultural extension officer
Consider crop rotation to break pest cycle
Document damage for insurance or government support
Isolate affected area to prevent spread

human_hazard.first_aid: No action needed. Wash hands after contact.

rice leaf roller.precautions: Wear gloves when handling plants affected by rice leaf roller. Avoid direct contact.
